6. Safe use of products

Many of our products are electrical, gas-powered, or made of glass or ceramic. For your safety:

  • Always read and follow the manufacturer's instructions and warnings before use.
  • Check that the voltage, plug type and power rating of electrical products suit your home before use.
  • Gas cookers and their connections must be installed and checked by a qualified person. Never use a gas appliance if you smell gas; turn off the supply, ventilate the area and get professional help.
  • Use only suitable cookware with induction cookers.
  • Glass and ceramic items can break or chip. Handle with care and do not use damaged items. Avoid sudden temperature changes unless the product is designed for it.
  • Keep appliances away from children and do not leave them unattended while in use.

We are not responsible for harm caused by misuse, incorrect installation, or not following the manufacturer's instructions.
